apis.name: list_places
apis.request_params: category, interest, district, region, search, verification_status, near_lat, near_lon, radius_km, limit, offset
apis.source_of_truth: PostgreSQL places table with fallback to data/places/places.json
apis.error_behavior: HTTP 200 with empty list [] on zero matches

apis.name: get_place_detail
apis.source_of_truth: PostgreSQL places table (resolves UUIDs and slug IDs like place_bbsr_001)
apis.error_behavior: HTTP 404 with error detail when place does not exist

apis.name: plan_itinerary
apis.request_model: PlanningConstraints (days, interests, start, pace, dates, etc.)
apis.source_of_truth: Deterministic ItineraryService with verified places and transport hops
apis.error_behavior: HTTP 422 with validation_error if unpermitted fields passed

apis.name: ai_converse
apis.response_model: GroundedConversationResponse (message, status, is_grounded, tool_calls, evidence_items, itinerary_preview)
apis.source_of_truth: GroundedConversationOrchestrator with tool-calling boundary (build_itinerary, search_places, get_provider_status)
apis.error_behavior: HTTP 422 if messages missing; falls back gracefully to deterministic tools if LLM unavailable

apis.name: current_weather
apis.source_of_truth: Open-Meteo adapter with fail-closed UNAVAILABLE/ERROR states (no fake 0C)
apis.error_behavior: HTTP 200 with status=UNAVAILABLE / ERROR when upstream fails

apis.name: list_routes
apis.error_behavior: HTTP 200 with empty list on no matches

apis.name: route_geometry
apis.error_behavior: HTTP 404 if route unknown; fails closed with ANCHOR_ONLY/CORRIDOR_ONLY and empty coordinates if gaps exist

apis.name: services_nearby
apis.request_params: lat, lon, category, subcategory, radius_km, limit
apis.error_behavior: HTTP 200 with services: [] if none within radius

apis.name: sync_saved_places
apis.source_of_truth: PostgreSQL saved_places table (requires auth or returns empty)
apis.error_behavior: HTTP 401 if unauthenticated for private sync
